base_conduits.name: Edge to cloud (IC-5)
base_conduits.purpose: IC-5 frames both ways over one outbound session the site opens; schedules are intents the edge checks, never device points. Signed update images (B1-06).

base_conduits.name: Edge control to DMZ
base_conduits.purpose: The edge's only path off site, re-originated at the DMZ. No human session crosses it: operators act on the edge only through audited IC-5 operator commands.

base_conduits.name: Edge to OEM BESS EMS/PPC
base_conduits.purpose: BESS setpoints and the site import limit, written from L2 only; the OEM PPC executes and protects (spec section 8, principle 3).

loss_trigger.reason: read-only context: IC-5 1.0.0 has no trigger for substation data

base_conduits.name: Edge reads substation
base_conduits.purpose: Station measurements and status for context; the edge never writes here.

base_conduits.name: DNO ANM to edge
base_conduits.purpose: The DNO's setpoint or trip in, the acknowledgement out; received and enforced at the edge with the cloud link up or down (B1-03, D119). Hardwired where the DNO requires it.

base_conduits.name: Edge reads metering
base_conduits.purpose: Import, export and asset meters. Modbus TCP is what this design asks of the operational meters; how revenue meters are read is a site fact (data ask).

loss_trigger.reason: read-only context: losing it removes context, not a control path

base_conduits.name: Edge reads facility power (UPS, EPMS, DCIM)
base_conduits.purpose: SNMPv3 and Modbus reads of the IT power chain; read-only by construction.

base_conduits.name: Site to route-to-market partner
base_conduits.purpose: Market instructions and availability, opened from the site. A partner instruction is an intent the edge checks against the envelope, never a device write.

loss_trigger.reason: human access only: losing it does not affect control

base_conduits.name: Brokered remote access
base_conduits.purpose: The site opens an outbound session to the broker; a person joins it with MFA. No port on site listens for an inbound session.

bms_variants.summary: No connection to the BMS: battery-only control.

caveat.reason: a true one-way path: nothing can reach the BMS

conduits.name: Edge reads the ThermaFlex adapter
conduits.purpose: Cooling telemetry and IC-11 availability, read through the adapter's interface.

conduits.name: BMS telemetry out through a data diode
conduits.purpose: The host's BMS pushes telemetry out; the hardware cannot carry anything back (NIST SP 800-82r3 E.1.2).

bms_variants.summary: The reference default: BMS telemetry out through a data diode; no chiller writes.

bms_variants.caveat: Two opposed one-way paths form a loop at the application level. The assurance comes from the single fixed message type, the protocol break and the host-side termination. This mode is not hardware-incapable of carrying data back to the edge, and must not be presented as if it were.

conduits.name: Edge to the ThermaFlex adapter (band offer)
conduits.purpose: The IC-5 chiller band, from L3 only, as an offer the adapter relays one way to the BMS.

conduits.name: BMS telemetry out through a data diode
conduits.purpose: The host's BMS pushes telemetry out; the hardware cannot carry anything back (NIST SP 800-82r3 E.1.2).

loss_trigger.reason: no acknowledgement path: loss shows on C7 as the host no longer adopting the offer

conduits.name: Chiller band offer in, one way
conduits.purpose: One message type only, a chiller band with a valid-until time, into a declared host-owned register. The host's BMS logic decides whether to adopt it; an expired offer is dropped and the BMS keeps its own schedule.

bms_variants.summary: Two opposed one-way paths: telemetry out, a chiller band offer in, adopted or ignored by the host's own BMS logic.

bms_variants.caveat: Kept because the spec allows a site without a diode. It is a listed gap in the SL2 review (GAP-62443-20).

conduits.name: Edge to the ThermaFlex adapter (chiller points)
conduits.purpose: Chiller setpoints and schedules agreed in the B1-09 safety case (TF-03), from L3 only.

conduits.name: Brokered BMS read and write
conduits.purpose: Allow-listed chiller setpoints and schedules written through a firewalled protocol break. A listed gap in the SL2 review: the host relies on software, not hardware.

bms_variants.summary: A firewalled, protocol-break conduit writing allow-listed chiller points.

spec.meaning: both ends present certificates; the session is encrypted and integrity-protected
the conduit runs inside an authenticated, encrypted tunnel across an untrusted network
a stateful boundary that permits only the listed endpoints, ports and protocols
protocol-aware inspection that passes only well-formed messages of the allowed functions
hardware that can carry data one way only (NIST SP 800-82r3 E.1.2)
the adapter has no write function for this conduit; a write cannot be expressed
only declared points of the declared classes are writable (B1-04; registers: WP-EDGE-03)
every frame names its predecessor by hash (IC-5 D114), so loss, replay and forks are seen
executable content is accepted only with a valid signature (B1-06, WP-EDGE-06)
every command is an IC-13 hash-chained audit event with the identity that issued it
the boundary logs every flow it permits or refuses, for monitoring and investigation
a hardwired signal with no network path, so it cannot be reached from any network
bounded message rate and size (IC-5 max_frame_bytes), so a flood cannot starve control
telemetry is buffered through a link outage and forwarded after it (B1-05, WP-EDGE-04)
a person is identified individually and authenticated with more than one factor
every brokered human session is recorded and can be terminated by the broker
the edge talks only to the device identities (address, port) commissioned for the conduit
the edge holds the IC-5 fail-safe target on any trigger, with no cloud message (B1-02)
every refused input gets a typed reason code (IC-5 RejectReason, frame verdicts)
an untrusted wall clock is the IC-5 trigger clock_unsynchronised and enters fail-safe
software enters the zone only as a signed image through the update channel (B1-06)
the zone's network configuration derives from this hashed design release
every asset in the zone is listed, with a site-level inventory from commissioning (B1-08)
the zone terminates each session and originates a new one; it never routes packets

invariants.name: conduit_ids_unique
invariants.statement: conduit ids unique

invariants.name: endpoints_are_zones
invariants.statement: endpoints are zones

invariants.name: purdue_adjacent
invariants.statement: A conduit joins zones whose Purdue levels overlap or are adjacent (NIST SP 800-82r3 5.2.3.1: rules only between adjacent levels; the DMZ sits between levels 3 and 4).

invariants.name: enterprise_reaches_only_dmz
invariants.statement: A zone at level 4 or 5 (the cloud, remote operations, the market partner) connects only to the DMZ: no cloud conduit lands on edge control or anything below it.

invariants.name: boundary_outbound_only
invariants.statement: Every conduit across the site boundary is opened from the site: nothing on site listens.

invariants.name: off_site_reaches_control_only_through_a_break
invariants.statement: With every protocol-break zone removed, no off-site zone reaches any on-site zone: every route from the internet to a controller is terminated and re-originated at least once.

invariants.name: anm_stays_on_site
invariants.statement: The DNO's ANM signal travels only on site and lands on the edge (D119): no conduit carrying it touches the cloud or any off-site zone.

invariants.name: writes_only_into_writable_zones
invariants.statement: A write lands only in a zone that admits that point class: never the UPS, EPMS or DCIM, the meters, the substation, the DNO's RTU or any off-site zone.

invariants.name: writer_opens_and_flows
invariants.statement: The writer opens the session, and data can flow from the writer to the written zone.

invariants.name: write_stage_matches_point_class
invariants.statement: A write's lowest stage is the highest `WRITE_MIN_STAGE` of its point classes, and every chiller or battery write needs the B1-09 safety case.

invariants.name: authority_matches_controls
invariants.statement: A write carries the write allow-list and IC-13 audit; a read-only conduit carries read-only-by-construction; a diode conduit carries the unidirectional gateway and is one way.

invariants.name: read_only_context_is_one_way
invariants.statement: Facility power, metering and the substation are read: data flows only out of them.

invariants.name: humans_use_mfa
invariants.statement: A person reaches the site only by a brokered session that ends at the DMZ, with MFA and session recording.

invariants.name: code_enters_only_signed
invariants.statement: Executable content travels only as a signed image, and only into a zone that admits code through the signed update channel alone (B1-06).

invariants.name: no_wireless_conduit
invariants.statement: Every conduit is wired: no protocol outside the listed wired set.

invariants.name: no_person_to_person_channel
invariants.statement: No conduit carries mail, chat or file sharing: only the listed machine payloads and the brokered human session.

invariants.name: loss_triggers_cover_ic5
invariants.statement: Every IC-5 comms-loss trigger names a conduit, so WP-EDGE-04 has a conduit to break for each fault-injection test. A mode with no BMS conduit has no thermal link to lose.

invariants.name: every_zone_is_reached
invariants.statement: every zone is reached

invariants.name: bms_mode_is_what_it_says
invariants.statement: D156. The variant's conduits touch only the BMS chain; L3 exactly when a chiller write exists; the diode mode writes nothing and lets nothing into the BMS; the band-offer mode has exactly two opposed one-way paths whose inbound one carries only the band offer into the host's zone.

invariants.name: adapter_relays_only_what_reaches_the_bms
invariants.statement: What the edge writes into the ThermaFlex adapter is exactly what the adapter may write into the BMS in that mode: the adapter is a relay, never a place where a write widens or dies.

review.disclaimer: Neura's own design review against the public SR identifiers and titles of IEC 62443-3-3. It is not certified and is not a conformity assessment. It was not checked against the purchased requirement text or its SL 2 requirement enhancements, and claims no achieved security level.

gaps.closes_when: A person holding the purchased IEC 62443-3-3 and 3-2 checks every SR and its SL 2 enhancements against this design and records the result.
gaps.statement: This review uses only the public SR identifiers and titles. Nobody has checked it against the purchased requirement text or the SL 2 requirement enhancements.

gaps.closes_when: WP-PLAT-06's identity service covers the broker's users, with tests.
gaps.statement: Human accounts, identifiers, authenticators, login handling and session handling for the remote-access broker are not designed here.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-03 either proves the gateway has no local login or designs and tests one.
gaps.statement: Local maintenance access at the site (a console or service port on the gateway or the DMZ equipment) is not designed; the reference design gives a person no path but C11.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-03 records, per adapter and site, whether a secure protocol variant is available and used, and tests the binding.
gaps.statement: The southbound fieldbus protocols as commonly deployed carry no device authentication; device binding pins addresses and ports only.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-03 designs and tests the gateway's key and certificate lifecycle.
gaps.statement: Certificate issuance, rotation and revocation, and key storage, for mutual TLS and the partner tunnel are not designed here.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-04 sizes the buffer with the 7-day store-and-forward and tests audit failure.
gaps.statement: The gateway's local audit buffer: its capacity across a link outage and what the edge does when it cannot record an audit event.

gaps.closes_when: WP-PLAT-06's audit_log is released with access control and tamper evidence, tested.
gaps.statement: Every command is an IC-13 audit event, but protection of and access to the audit store belong to the audit log service.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-03 chooses and tests the time source and its loss and drift handling.
gaps.statement: The edge's time source and its protection are not chosen; the design only makes an untrusted clock a fail-safe trigger.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-03 decides whether per-frame signatures are needed and, if so, an IC-5 minor version adds them.
gaps.statement: IC-5 1.0.0 frames carry no per-frame signature: integrity rests on mutual TLS and the hash chain northbound, and on the protocol and the boundary southbound.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-06 releases the signed update channel with execution control on the gateway.
gaps.statement: Only the update path is designed (signed images). Protection against malicious code already on the gateway or brought to it is not.

gaps.closes_when: WP-GRC-10's OT penetration test exercises each conduit's controls.
gaps.statement: Nothing yet verifies the security functions on real equipment (firewall rules, diode, allow-list, outbound-only).

gaps.closes_when: WP-TEL-05's retention and segregation policy covers the edge buffer.
gaps.statement: Confidentiality of data at rest on the gateway (the telemetry buffer) and its purge at decommissioning are not designed.

gaps.closes_when: The host answers the facility network and segmentation asks for the site.
gaps.statement: The design segments a generic site. Whether a real facility's network can host these zones and conduits is unknown until the host answers the network asks.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-03 designs and tests process isolation on the gateway.
gaps.statement: The gateway runs adapters, the IC-5 client and the policy engine in one box; how they are isolated from each other is not designed.

gaps.closes_when: WP-OPS-04 raises alarms from the boundary logs and the IC-5 events.
gaps.statement: Flows are logged at every boundary, but nothing yet watches the logs or alarms on them.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-03 sets and tests per-process resource limits.
gaps.statement: Conduit rate limits are designed; resource limits inside the gateway are not.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-06 keeps the previous signed image and configuration for rollback.
gaps.statement: Backup of the gateway's image and configuration is not designed.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-04 releases the gateway image with a tested restore procedure.
gaps.statement: Telemetry recovery after an outage is designed (store and forward); rebuilding a failed gateway to a known state is not.

gaps.closes_when: The host answers the emergency power ask for the site.
gaps.statement: Whether the gateway, DMZ equipment and diode can sit on the facility's backed-up supply is a site fact.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-07's commissioning record carries the site's configuration and inventory.
gaps.statement: The design pins a baseline and lists asset classes; each site's configuration and inventory come from commissioning.

gaps.closes_when: WP-GRC-10 tests that boundary at any site using the mode, and the site records why the diode modes were refused.
gaps.statement: In the brokered_bidirectional BMS mode the boundary in front of the BMS is software (a firewall and a protocol break), not hardware.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-07 sets the commissioning device and media rules.
gaps.statement: Portable devices brought to site (commissioning laptops, removable media) are not covered by the design.

gaps.closes_when: WP-EDGE-03 releases the write allow-list and tests it against this design's classes.
gaps.statement: The design fixes the point classes that may be written; the registers behind each class (the allow-list itself) are not yet built.

zones.name: Neura cloud (live optimisation)
zones.purpose: Plans setpoint schedules inside the IC-3 envelope and sends them as IC-5 frames.

zones.name: Remote operations access broker
zones.purpose: The only route a person takes to the site; sessions are brokered, never inbound to site.

zones.name: Route-to-market partner
zones.purpose: Owns market execution (ADR-D2); exchanges market signals with the site.

zones.name: Site DMZ
zones.purpose: Terminates every off-site session; nothing routes through it (NIST SP 800-82r3 5.2.3.1).

zones.name: Neura edge control
zones.purpose: Holds the safety-critical constraints autonomously and writes only allow-listed points.

assets: ThermaFlex adapter, reached through a controlled interface (AWAIT-19)
zones.name: ThermaFlex BMS adapter
zones.purpose: Translates IC-11 and chiller bands to BACnet/Modbus; Neura sees only its interface.

zones.name: OEM BESS EMS and PPC
zones.purpose: Certified control and protection (E-08); runs Neura's setpoints inside its own limits.

zones.name: Site substation
zones.purpose: Read-only context for the edge; who owns it is a site fact (data ask).

zones.name: DNO RTU and ANM interface
zones.purpose: Sends ANM setpoints and trips to the edge, which enforces them locally (D119).

zones.name: Facility BMS and chiller plant
zones.purpose: The host's cooling control; the host's own logic stays in charge of the chillers.

zones.name: Metering
zones.purpose: Import, export and asset measurement; the meter operator is a site fact (data ask).

zones.name: Facility power context (read-only)
zones.purpose: Read-only context on the IT power chain; never written (B1-01, TF-03).
